headline: Dynamo paper reports GPU-resident state reuse cuts LLM-serving recovery to seconds
summary: A Sept. 21 preprint from NVIDIA authors presents GPU Memory Service (GMS), initialized-runtime snapshots and Shadow Engines for recovering LLM inference replicas without reloading model weights when a worker process fails but its GPU remains intact. Across four eight-GPU model configurations on vLLM and SGLang, the paper reports Shadow Engine recovery in 4.6–6.2 seconds, 12.8–29.0× faster than a warm restart. A separate replay of the authors’ production failure trace estimates 79% of recovery-related GPU-hours could be reclaimed. These are author-reported results for device-preserving process failures; device loss and broader deployment behavior remain open.
